subject: Animation
title: Shaun the Sheep: Dialogue-Free Comedy
description: A quick win: understand Shaun the Sheep: Dialogue-Free Comedy.

hook.text: Shaun the Sheep started as a background character in a Wallace and Gromit short and got his own series.

buildup.text: The show has no dialogue at all. Every joke and story beat is communicated through physical comedy alone.

discovery.text: Without language barriers, Shaun the Sheep became one of the most internationally popular animated shows.

twist.text: The silent format was born from budget necessity. Aardman could not afford voice recording for every episode.

climax.text: A constraint became a superpower. Shaun airs in over 170 countries without needing a single translation.

punchline.text: The funniest sheep in the world never says a word.

quiz.question: Why does Shaun the Sheep use no dialogue?
options: Budget constraints led to a silent format that became a global advantage, airing without translation
British law prohibits speaking animals on television
